title: The frontend puts a breadcrumb trail above the back link on almost every page; DR1 has no breadcrumbs anywhere in the service.

finding.frontend: Every page inside a notification opens with a two-step breadcrumb trail — "Your notifications" linking to the dashboard, then the page's own title — sitting above the back link. 30 of the 33 captured screens show a trail with items in it. The trail is always exactly two steps regardless of how deep the page sits, so on the address picker it reads "Your notifications > Place of origin" and says nothing about the addresses hub the user came through. The two dashboard screens are worse: they render the breadcrumb navigation landmark with an empty list inside it, so a screen-reader user is announced a breadcrumb that contains nothing. Only the overview page renders no breadcrumb markup at all. The layout builds the trail by default for any page with a title at src/server/app/shared/layout.njk:41-49, using the copy at src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js:14-16.
finding.prototype: There are no breadcrumbs on any of DR1's 40 captured screens. A user's route back up is the service navigation bar at the top of the page — Dashboard, Address book — and the back link, and nothing else. DR1 states no third route out of a page.
finding.difference: Remove the breadcrumb trail, leaving the back link as the only in-page route backwards. There are four places to touch, not one: the default trail in the shared layout at src/server/app/shared/layout.njk:41-49; the trail builder at src/server/app/shared/paths.js:12-15, which hard-codes "Your notifications" rather than reading it from copy; the `breadcrumbs` leaf in src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js:14-16 and its Welsh pair; and the global Nunjucks default `breadcrumbs: []` at src/config/nunjucks/context/context.js:36, which is outside src/server/app and is what makes the two dashboard screens render an empty breadcrumb landmark. Only one page passes an explicit value — src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/controller.js:72 — and the overview passes `breadcrumbs: false` at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/controller.js:168; both callers go with the rest. This should not land before the service navigation carries a Dashboard item, because until it does the breadcrumb is the only always-present link to the notification list and removing it would leave a user mid-notification with nothing but the back link. Once the nav is populated the two say the same thing twice, in two places, which is what DR1 avoids.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a breadcrumb element rendered in any DR1 root view or in any of the 40 captured prototype DOMs.
finding.correction: Claim sound, the work was understated, and the difference slot is corrected. Counts re-derived from the DOMs: 30 of 33 frontend screens render a two-item trail, the two dashboards render `govuk-breadcrumbs` with an empty `<ol>` inside it, and only the overview renders no breadcrumb markup at all — so both edge cases the finding names are real and both are inside the finding rather than only in a report. The trail is exactly two items on every one of the 30, including the address pickers. `breadcrumb` appears in 0 of the 40 prototype DOMs. What the finding missed is where the change lands. The empty dashboard landmark is not a quirk of the layout: the global Nunjucks context sets `breadcrumbs: []` for every view (src/config/nunjucks/context/context.js:36), the layout's guard only rejects the literal `false`, and the empty array is truthy in the inline-if, so any view that does not set its own value renders an empty trail. And the "Your notifications" string is written twice — once in shared copy, once as a literal in paths.js:13 — so removing it from copy alone would leave the trail intact and untranslated.

relatedTo.why: the breadcrumb is the only always-present route to the notification list until the navigation bar carries a Dashboard item
